capabilities: count Chinese characters, English words, digits, and punctuation in the active note
show occurrences of seven built-in common Chinese characters
count user-defined custom characters or terms
display statistics in a right-sidebar view with manual refresh
extract readable text from rendered Markdown, excluding frontmatter, code, and embeds
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents limitations: no continuous refresh while editing, no selected-text counting, and Chinese counting limited to the U+4E00–U+9FFF range.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count doesn't break down Chinese character usage or let writers track frequency of specific characters and terms they care about.
summary: Text-statistics plugin that counts readable Chinese characters and English words in the active note, with common-character and custom-term counts in a sidebar view.
